text: I see. Now, in terms of a wheel then. would a better idea then be to where i can create a wheel of any size. and it can be sized to fit the car model from the wheel well from this equation
resolution: Built 'create a wheel sized to the well from the fit'. New pure helpers: wheelMesh(radius,width,sides,axle) = a cylinder reoriented so its axle runs along the well normal (loops reversed after the coord swap so tread normals stay outward); mergeMesh(a,b,delta) appends b's verts (reindexed) + faces into a at an offset. Studio '⊚ make wheel' button (vertex mode, 3+ arch verts): fit the well, generate a tire of exactly that radius (width=radius*0.5, 16 sides) and merge it into the body at the centre. Merged → liftToGround re-seats the car on the tire bottoms = ride height (also resolves req_1205). Mirror-aware: a reflected copy per non-empty subset of enabled planes (one well + Z = both wheels, X+Z = all four). editMesh suite 67/67, cart bundles clean. Committed 92db3543e.
